source_profile: Aggregated panel signal across Shark Tank - Gen X (2026-08-26) and cross-file 45-54 / 55-64 index reads.
one_line: US adults 45 to 60. Latchkey generation grown up. Peak-earning, peak-caregiving (both kids and aging parents), still on Facebook, still watches cable, still buys the CD equivalent. Alt-rock, classic-rock, and Nashville-country stack. F1 and Formula-adjacent, NHL, college football. Costco and Trader Joe's same-cart. Fidelity and Vanguard, not Robinhood.

demographics.age_range: 45 to 60. Density in 45-54 (idx 442) and 55-64 (idx 343). 65+ and 35-44 fall below 6.
demographics.gender_skew: Roughly 50 male / 47 female. Non-binary and trans identifiers present but at a much lower share than any younger generation. Read as gender-binary on the surface, slight female pull on wellness / cooking / craft and slight male pull on finance / sports / motorsports.
demographics.income_band: Every band sits near 100 to 104. Peak-earning decade. HHI median leans $95K to $135K. Meaningful upper-tail at $250K-plus. Real assets: home equity, 401(k), college savings, second-property adjacency.
demographics.education: Some College / Associate 140, Bachelors 118, Graduate 96, HS or less 68. Mixed college and trade generation.
demographics.occupation_skew: Management / business / professional 115, Healthcare 84, STEM 106, Trade and skilled labor over-represented vs Millennials.
demographics.ethnicity_skew: White 104, Hispanic 94, Black 94, Asian 90. Read as majority-white with meaningful minority representation, less diverse than Millennials or Gen Z.
demographics.life_stage: Married 135, Divorced 174 (this is the peak-divorce decade), Single 40, In a relationship 113. Has children under 12 idx 166 (many are late-in-life parents plus blended-family parents), also a heavy teen-and-college-age-parent load. Sandwich generation: caregiving both up and down.
geo_skew: Atlanta Ga (broader suburban and Rust Belt lean than Millennials)

values: Self-reliance and skepticism. Grew up with divorce, MTV, no seatbelts, and Watergate replay. Trusts what they can measure.
Peak-earning-plus-peak-caregiving braid. Aging parents plus teenage kids plus college-tuition bills plus a mortgage all at once. Sandwich-generation stress is real.
Cable still on. Facebook still open. LinkedIn 214, Facebook 174 (heaviest social of any generation), Pinterest 181 for the recipe stack.
Cash-flow-first finance posture. Fidelity 376, Vanguard 245, Charles Schwab 438, Edward Jones 418. This is the traditional-broker generation.

Alt-rock, classic-rock, and Nashville-country stack. Led Zeppelin (672), Journey (489), Blondie (549), Limp Bizkit (456), Tool (407), Pantera (390), Rascal Flatts (409), Dierks Bentley (355), Darius Rucker (354).
Formula 1 crossover fandom (Porsche Racing, F1 TV). NHL loyalty (Nashville Predators, Islanders, Wild). College football and NASCAR adjacency.
Costco loyalty (COSTCO OPTICAL 1,641, COSTCO 374). QVC (828) actually watched, not ironic.

Read privacy-and-tech news through a slightly-suspicious frame. On Truth Social (405) or Parler (710) in a non-trivial share (Fox / conservative-media pull is stronger here than in Millennials or Gen Z).

filter_rules_for_agent: KEEP items headlined by Gen X-coded talent: Julia Roberts, Sandra Bullock, Reese Witherspoon, Jennifer Aniston, Denzel Washington, Tom Hanks, Brad Pitt, George Clooney, Kevin Costner, Nick Offerman, Aubrey Plaza, Tina Fey, Amy Poehler, Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Steve Carell, Billy Bob Thornton, Danny DeVito, Connie Britton, Mariska Hargitay, Taraji P Henson, Sarah Jessica Parker, Jennifer Garner, Chris Rock.

KEEP prestige slower-burn TV: Slow Horses, The Diplomat, The Morning Show, Silo, Foundation, The Old Man, Bosch, Reacher, Jack Ryan, Yellowstone, 1883, 1923, Landman, Lioness, Tulsa King, MobLand, Ted Lasso, The Bear, Only Murders, White Lotus, Yellowjackets, Beef, Severance, Succession, Bridgerton (edge), Ozark, Lincoln Lawyer, Peaky Blinders, The Last of Us, House of the Dragon.

KEEP prestige nonfiction, biography, political history: Erik Larson, Walter Isaacson, Patrick Radden Keefe, Ron Chernow, Ken Burns adjacent, Doris Kearns Goodwin. KEEP spy thrillers: Baldacci, Silva, Grisham, Michael Connelly, Louise Penny. KEEP prestige literary fiction: Franzen, Chabon, Patchett, Strout, Whitehead, George Saunders. KEEP finance-and-retirement: John Bogle canon, Ramit Sethi, Peter Attia (Outlive), James Clear (Atomic Habits).

KEEP classic-rock and 90s-alt-rock canon: Led Zeppelin, Fleetwood Mac, Bruce Springsteen, U2, Tom Petty, R.E.M., Nirvana, Pearl Jam, Soundgarden, Foo Fighters, Tool, Metallica, Rage Against the Machine, Cranberries, No Doubt, Sarah McLachlan. KEEP Nashville-country: Chris Stapleton, Zach Bryan, Dierks Bentley, Darius Rucker, Rascal Flatts, Florida Georgia Line, Morgan Wallen. KEEP adult R&B and 90s hip-hop: Alicia Keys, John Legend, Jay-Z, OutKast, Kanye pre-2018, Beyonce. KEEP Norah Jones, Adele, Bonnie Raitt, Brandi Carlile.

KEEP prestige podcasts and Gen X-core hosts: The Daily, Ezra Klein, New Yorker Radio Hour, Fresh Air, Freakonomics, Planet Money, How I Built This, Tim Ferriss, Huberman, Peter Attia, Rich Roll, Bill Simmons, Ringer NFL Show, Pardon My Take, Pod Save America, Prosecuting Donald Trump, Rachel Maddow (edge), SmartLess, Armchair Expert, Revisionist History, 60 Minutes.

KEEP sports as full-season commitment: Sunday NFL, Sunday golf (Masters, US Open, PGA Championship, LPGA Solheim), fantasy football coverage, F1 Sundays (Drive to Survive, Netflix Full Speed), NHL Playoffs, MLB Playoffs, NBA Playoffs, college football (SEC / Big Ten), US Open Tennis, Wimbledon.
KEEP Formula 1 / motorsports: any F1 race coverage, Porsche Racing, IndyCar, Le Mans, NASCAR Chase Elliott / Kyle Larson stories.

KEEP home-improvement / craft: HGTV shows, Magnolia Network programming, backyard smoker (Traeger, Big Green Egg), Yeti product news, Milwaukee / Ryobi / DeWalt tool news, kitchen renovation, wine club news, whiskey and bourbon.

KEEP travel: Hyatt / Marriott / Ritz / Four Seasons news, boutique hotel launches, Michelin Guide announcements, cruise lines (edge; Viking and Holland America read more for Boomers), F1 destination weekends.

KEEP peak-earning / retirement finance: 401(k) news, IRA rollover, backdoor Roth, HYSA, index funds, Vanguard / Fidelity / Charles Schwab / Edward Jones product news, Bogleheads-style content, real-estate rate news, home-equity line stories.
KEEP wellness stack: Oura Ring, Whoop, Apple Watch, sleep hygiene, protein-per-meal, resistance training, cold plunge, sober-curious (Athletic Brewing, Ghia, Cann), Huberman / Peter Attia protocols.
KEEP AI-at-work stories: Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Notion AI, Salesforce Einstein. Drop AI stories that read as Gen Z homework tools or gaming AI.

KEEP casual-dining and steakhouse news (Outback, Longhorn, Cheesecake Factory, Carrabbas, LongHorn, Cracker Barrel edge). KEEP QSR mass-consumer news (Chick-fil-A, Dunkin, Starbucks, Panera, Cava, Chipotle).

KEEP puzzle games: Wordle, NYT Games, Connections, Spelling Bee, Chess.com, GeoGuessr. KEEP franchise gaming for the nostalgia / co-op-with-teen: Star Wars, Age of Empires, LEGO, Tony Hawk, Halo, Call of Duty (as parent-teen co-op).
KEEP prestige stand-up and comedy features: Chris Rock, Jerry Seinfeld, Bill Burr, John Mulaney, Ali Wong, Nate Bargatze, Jim Gaffigan, Sarah Silverman.
KEEP aging-parent-caregiver stories: memory-care, hospice, POA, Medicare enrollment for a parent, sandwich-generation coverage. This surface is genuinely useful for Gen X.
DROP hyper-Gen Z content: TikTok-first framing without substantive read, hyper-native Gen Z slang, Kai Cenat, Alix Earle, Nara Aziza, Salish Matter as PRIMARY items.
DROP K-pop and anime as PRIMARY (Hazbin Hotel, Helluva Boss, KPop Demon Hunters, Genshin Impact deep-cuts). K-pop mainstream (Newjeans, BTS) can pass as MID.
DROP BookTok romantasy as PRIMARY (a slice reads it, but the majority does not). Sarah J. Maas, Rebecca Yarros pass at MID at best; Ana Huang, Colleen Hoover fall further.
DROP reality-dating on cable as PRIMARY (Bachelor, Love Island, 90 Day Fiance).
DROP crypto-and-meme-stock trading content. Coinbase feature news is fine; 'why crypto will save you' takes are not. Robinhood coverage passes only if it is a policy or safety story.
DROP youth-influencer creator news (MrBeast is OK because he crosses over; PewDiePie, Markiplier fall to MID; Kai Cenat, Livvy Dunne, Salish Matter drop).
DROP evangelical-prosperity market: TBN, Pure Flix, 700 Club, Great American Family, Kirk Cameron content, Christian Nationalist framing.
DROP AARP / Medicare Supplement / retirement-community coverage as PRIMARY (starts to matter more late-Gen-X but not core yet). Life-alert, senior-caregiver-for-self is DROP.
DROP hustle-bro grindset, Andrew Tate, alpha-bro, wall-street-alpha, get-rich-quick trading-guru content.

DROP openly conservative culture-war messaging (Ben Shapiro, Charlie Kirk, Matt Walsh, Candace Owens, PragerU, Turning Point USA). Note: a slice of Gen X reads this content but the tab-wide bar is DROP unless the item is genuinely news.
DROP kids-only franchises without adult-crossover (Paw Patrol, Peppa Pig, Bluey) unless the parent-comedy angle is the story.

TIE-BREAK when unsure: does this touch peak-career money, prestige-slower-burn TV, full-season sports fandom, classic / alt rock / country, home / craft / wine / whiskey, aging-parent caregiving, or a Gen X-coded talent? If yes, lean KEEP. If it reads as content aimed at their teen or their grandma, lean DROP.
expected_kept_share_per_tab: 25-45% of items per tab. Prestige TV and slower-burn film should retain a healthy share. Podcasts skew high because Gen X is one of the heaviest prestige-podcast cohorts. BookTok and K-pop drag Books and Songs lower. Headlines and Searches narrow the hardest because a lot of youth-culture-first items fall out.
